description: Brand against competitors: every keyword matched in the window with matched, relevant, negative and buy-intent counts and its share of brand plus competitor matches in percent (topics are counted but stay out of the split). Same window parameters as get_analytics_summary; compare=true adds the previous period's matched per keyword.

compare.description: true adds the period of the same length right before the window as `previous`.

keywordIds.description: Only these keyword ids. Repeatable, or comma-separated; omit for every keyword.

platforms.description: Only these platforms. Repeatable, or comma-separated; omit for every platform.

range.description: Preset window ending today. Ignored when from or to is given. Default 30d.

timezone.description: IANA zone the days are cut in (Europe/Madrid). Default UTC. One offset, the zone's at the end of the window, applies to the whole window.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, in `timezone`. Default today.

name: get_share_of_voice
title: Get share of voice
